title: FIES the high-resolution fibre-fed echelle spectrograph at the Nordic Optical Telescope
what_was_studied: Spectrograph design, fibre modes and performance
numerical_result: FIES provides resolving-power modes up to about 67000 over broad visible coverage
remaining_question: It was designed for general stellar spectroscopy rather than the most stable EPRV work

title: FIES bundle D commissioning
numerical_result: Seven K-dwarf observations over 12 days gave 3.3 m/s RMS at signal-to-noise about 70
remaining_question: A seven-point sequence is not a long-term floor

title: FIES RV stability test based on ThAr spectra
what_was_studied: Long calibration sequences, exposure meter and wavelength solution
numerical_result: The study identified exposure-meter placement and wavelength-fit structure as significant error terms
remaining_question: Calibration-only sequences do not include the stellar light path

title: Five m/s ten-month stability with FIES
numerical_result: The report found about 5 m/s accuracy over ten months in its stated reduction
remaining_question: The result is one target and one configuration rather than general instrument performance

title: FIES instrument documentation
what_was_studied: Current technical pages and observer resources
numerical_result: The NOT maintains current FIES observer and development documentation
remaining_question: A separate dated semester-offering source should still be attached
